description: Deep research across 9 podcast transcript and blog archives: Gastropod, Freakonomics Radio, Planet Money, The Indicator, 20K Hz, 99% Invisible, SatPost, Acquired, and Business Breakdowns.

novel_features.name: Parallel Multi-Source Search
novel_features.description: Search all 9 podcast transcript and blog archives in parallel with goroutine-based fan-out, keyword scoring, and transcript deep-fetch for high-scoring matches.

novel_features.name: Stdin-Supplied Topic
novel_features.description: Read search topic from stdin when no positional argument is provided, enabling pipe workflows like echo topic | trivia-research-pp-cli research --json.

novel_features.name: Compact Agent Synthesis Output
novel_features.description: Produces structured markdown with per-source sections, ranked evidence clusters, and emoji-tree stats footer designed for LLM agent consumption.
